tools.name: get_company_buybacks_sbc
tools.description: Retrieve SEC EDGAR XBRL-backed Buybacks vs. Stock-Based Compensation (SBC), RSU tax withholdings, Standard FCF, True FCF (FCF minus SBC), cover-page shares vs. weighted-average diluted shares, and clickable 10-K/20-F/10-Q filing links for any of 10,400+ U.S. public companies.

tools.name: compare_companies_dilution
tools.description: Compare two U.S. public companies head-to-head on SEC EDGAR 10-K buybacks, stock-based compensation (SBC), RSU tax withholdings, True FCF (FCF minus SBC), and diluted share-count change.

tools.name: get_sec_screen
tools.description: Query WeightedShares quantitative SEC EDGAR screens across flagship U.S. companies: true share cannibals, largest buyback programs, heavy SBC diluters, negative SBC-adjusted FCF (True FCF traps, excluding banks/insurers/REITs), hidden RSU tax cash drains, or 12M Form 4 insider selling vs. buybacks.

tools.name: get_superinvestor_dilution
tools.description: Audit a legendary superinvestor's latest SEC Form 13F-HR U.S. equity holdings for weighted diluted share drift, SBC % of revenue, and True FCF margins. Pass slug='list' to enumerate all available superinvestors.

tools.name: search_sec_companies
tools.description: Search across 10,400+ SEC EDGAR-registered U.S. public companies by ticker or company name.
